title: Prime Minister hails India’s historic best-ever performance and record 114 medals at the Asian Para Games 2026
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today lauded the extraordinary achievement of India's para-athletes at the just concluded Asian Para Games 2026. The Prime Minister highlighted that with a record 114 medals, this marks India’s best-ever performance at the Games, noting that this is an occasion of immense pride and joy for the entire nation. He congratulated every member of the contingent for their exceptional determination, emphasizing that each athlete has contributed to this historic achievement and inspired countless Indians with their accomplishments. The Prime Minister shared on X: "What an extraordinary achievement by our para-athletes at the just concluded Asian Para Games 2026! With a record 114 medals, this marks India’s best-ever performance at the Games. This is an occasion of immense pride and joy for the entire nation! I congratulate every member of our contingent for their exceptional determination. Each athlete has contributed to this historic achievement and inspired countless Indians with their accomplishments."
